reviews.text:
Beautiful mosque with a welcoming community. However, I have two important hygiene concerns that I hope the management will address.
First, visitors remove their outdoor shoes in the same area where others stand in socks or barefoot before entering the prayer hall. This increases the risk of tracking dirt, bacteria, and other contaminants into the prayer area.
Second, the shared slippers in the ablution (wudu) area may contribute to the spread of athlete's foot and other fungal skin infections if they are not regularly sanitized. Encouraging visitors to bring their own slippers or providing a sanitization system would be a much healthier solution.
Massachusetts public health regulations emphasize maintaining shared areas in a clean and sanitary condition to protect public health.
Massachusetts General Court +1
Cleanliness is half of faith. I hope the mosque will consider these improvements to provide a cleaner and healthier environment for everyone.
reviews.name: Frank Abigail

reviews.text:
It feels awkward to give a mosque a "review" but given that it is the only mosque near me, my efforts to connect with this mosque's community have been disappointingly unsuccessful. I have been hoping it would be a place that I could regularly attend salah (not just jummah) and find community. I have been disappointed in this regard.

I have attempted to contact this mosque in several ways and have gotten no response. The one exception was placing a phone call to one of the numbers I found as a possibility. That call was screened and then a man called me back. We had a short conversation and he told me he would help me be connected with women in the community. That never happened. It appears this mosque has no organized program for women at all. reviews.text:
I have been coming to this mosque for quite a long time, and it has always been a wonderful place with a welcoming community and truly knowledgeable scholars.

I especially want to express my sincere gratitude to Imam Zubair. I have visited many different mosques over the years, but I can confidently say that his depth of knowledge, wisdom, and ability to explain even complex Islamic topics in such a clear, meaningful, and heart-touching way are truly exceptional. His lectures are not only educational but also spiritually uplifting, leaving a lasting impact on those who listen.

Our community truly needed an imam like him, and Alhamdulillah, Allah has blessed us with one. His dedication, sincerity, and contributions to this community are invaluable.

May Allah bless Imam Zubair, increase him in knowledge, and reward him abundantly for everything he does for our community. Ameen!
